headings.usage: Use Manrope for all headers to convey a friendly, humanistic tone suitable for mental health.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for long form text, ticket summaries, and data tables.

colors.rules: Never use pure black (#000000) or pure grey (#808080). Tint greys with green or warm sand to maintain the organic feel. High contrast for readability without harsh neon.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use very soft, ambient shadows. Example: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(58,90,64,0.06)] for elevated cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border on cards and widgets. Soft 12px (rounded-xl) to 16px (rounded-2xl) radius for a safe, friendly feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise texture overlay to the main background to break digital flatness and create a grounded, organic environment.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid on clinical data. For modals or sticky navs, use high opacity with blur (e.g., bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40).

layouts.dashboard: Collapsible left sidebar for navigation + spacious modular widgets area. Prioritize progressive disclosure for ticket data to prevent cognitive overload.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for main sections, gap-6 to gap-8 in grids. Content must breathe.

grids.widget_ratios: Summary stats span 1 col, main tables span 2 or 3 cols. Maintain rigid optical alignment.
grids.general: Never fill 100% perfectly without breathing room. Use subgrid when nesting.

components.ticket_card: Cardless or very flat rectangular shapes with 1px border. Displays Helper avatar, Name, and Discord ID tag.
components.ai_summary_panel: Inside the ticket detail, housed in a distinct but muted container (bg-ai_highlight_bg). Structured cleanly: Context, Needs, Actions, Next Follow-up.
components.helper_assignment: Use a Shadcn Select/Dropdown customized with avatar previews, Name, and Discord ID inline.
components.role_gate: Admin View must be strictly visible only to Discord Role ID 1503100661728936046.
components.general_rules: DO NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn components for Select, Tabs, Dialogs, Tables. Customize border-radii and spacing.

motion.transitions: Gentle microinteractions. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO universal transitions.
motion.loading: Subtle skeleton loaders in earthy tones. Avoid jarring spinners.
motion.hover: Explicitly set hover colors. Lighter hue of the active state. E.g., hover:bg-[#2B4330] hover:text-white

accessibility.contrast: APCA minimums required. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast, ring-2 ring-[#3A5A40].
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React (.js) using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui primitives.
Implement the Ticket Detail page. Include an 'Assisted by...' section that displays a selected main helper's Name and Discord ID, using a styled Select component.
Integrate an AI summary section on each ticket made with Gemini (using Emergent Universal Key) that formats strictly into: Context, Expressed Needs, Actions, and Next Follow-up.
Build a protected Admin Panel Dashboard restricted to users with Discord Role ID '1503100661728936046'.
The admin dashboard must display an overview of all helpers and their assigned tickets, using progressive disclosure (collapsible lists or modals) to maintain a calm UI.
Adhere closely to the 'Organic & Earthy' mental-health color palette and generous spacing guidelines.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for UI iconography. Do NOT use emojis.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, on-distribution outputs.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
NEVER use a completely transparent background in header or surfaces overlaying content.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties only.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with relevant animations.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical to create a premium, calm feel.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
